resources.string: To get started, only notification access and at least one monitored app are required. Luminous, security and automations can be configured later.
Android will not let you enable access?
If you installed the APK manually, open App info, use the top-right menu and allow restricted settings, then return here and try again. The wording may vary by device.
Notification access is active. Choose at least one app to monitor.
Luminous, flash, biometric protection and advanced options stay available after setup, when you actually need them.
